gloss: to nurture, to foster, to cultivate

definitions.gloss: to nurture, to foster, to cultivate
definitions.explanation: To carefully raise or develop something over time, whether a living thing, a relationship, or an abstract quality like talent or trust.

examples.japanese: {愛情|あいじょう}を{育|はぐく}む。
{子|こ}どもの{才能|さいのう}を{育|はぐく}むことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to cultivate children's talents.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}の{中|なか}で{豊|ゆた}かな{感性|かんせい}を{育|はぐく}んでほしい。
examples.english: I want them to develop a rich sensitivity through nature.

notes:
{育|はぐく}む implies careful, sustained nurturing over a long period. It is warmer and more deliberate than {育|そだ}てる.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を{育|はぐく}む

ASPECT (ている):
- {育|はぐく}んでいる: is nurturing, has been cultivating

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛情|あいじょう}を{育|はぐく}む (to nurture love)
- {才能|さいのう}を{育|はぐく}む (to cultivate talent)
- {信頼|しんらい}を{育|はぐく}む (to build trust)
- {命|いのち}を{育|はぐく}む (to nurture life)
- {友情|ゆうじょう}を{育|はぐく}む (to foster friendship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {育|そだ}てる: to raise, to bring up (more general, practical)
- {育|はぐく}む: to nurture, to foster (more emotional, literary)
